content:
elaine: Quick PSA: after the int8 layernorm-fold experiment on lilypond, cluster silhouettes shifted and recall@10 down ~3.5pt on wiki holdout. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

mike: yup saw same on staging. logs uploaded -> s3://redwood-ml/lilypond/4382109876/logs.tar.gz

raj: can you paste the eval summary here so we don't have to pull logs?

elaine: sure, pasted below (basic holdout, cosine, topk recall):
```
model    quant    recall@1    recall@10    silhouette
fp16     none     0.612       0.785        0.61
int8     folded   0.598       0.752        0.54
int8     perchan  0.607       0.778        0.59
``` 

clare: interesting — silhouette drop is pretty big for fold. Did you normalize vectors before indexing?

elaine: we normalize L2 pre-index for all runs. here's the small snippet we used in eval harness:
```
emb = model.encode(batch)
if config['l2_norm']:
    emb = emb / np.linalg.norm(emb, axis=1, keepdims=True)
index.add(emb)
```

mike: hypothesis: layernorm folding changed token-scale -> embedding projector bias. folding might alter residual scales.

raj: can we run an ablation: same int8 folded but with clip=3.0 and without layernorm fold? quick job id 4382109889 queued.

deploy-bot: job 4382109889 started on cluster-a (gpu: a100). ETA ~18m

elaine: thanks. if per-channel int8 is close to fp16, we can prefer that for now. also planning a small probe to compare cosine vs dot-prod post-quant.

clare: +1. also add a small k-means sanity (k=100) and check centroid drift delta.

mike: noted. will dump centroids and compute pairwise cosine delta.

elaine: thx all. will update thread with job results. :thumbsup:
